name: minh-skills
description: Minh Duong's personal Claude Code marketplace — skills he built and uses himself.

plugins.name: minh-toolkit
plugins.description: Minh's personal skill collection — 8 skills: goal-to-code-unblock (coaches writing code from a vague goal, never authors it), learn-technology-by-building (multi-session mentor for learning a technology through one cumulative project), low-power-learning (short passive session for a tired/burned-out brain), real-personal-branding (branding for real outcomes, not vanity metrics), socratic-brainstorm (opt-in, probes an idea with questions before giving direct feedback), sound-human (makes AI-written prose read like a person wrote it), writing-practice (coaches deliberate writing practice, never writes the piece for you), and youtube-video-critic (evaluates whether a video is worth watching; requires the go-youtube-mcp-cli connector on PATH or YOUTUBE_MCP_BIN set — see .mcp.json).
